page_note: Page 114 is a remarkably pure stretch of cosmological substrate. The teaching narrates the Father of Life's ascent to the Height, his washing/expelling of the wheel of stars, the casting down of the dragon (Error/Sarme) into the salt sea, and the sealing of the boundary of the sea with the seals of moments, hours, days, months, years, the character of the stars, and the zodiac signs. The cosmos-as-coin-mold simile (segs 29-33) — craftsman casting holokotinoi into the fire — is itself a substratic correspondential figure (technē mapped onto cosmogenesis), not pastoral application. No dialogue frame, no ecclesial vocabulary, no polemic, no hortatory address. Teaching purity 0.882 confirms the reading. Heavy damage (38.2%) but the cosmological narrative thread is unbroken throughout.
